description: Header file defining the Schedules class for managing broadcast schedule data, including nested classes Sink and Parser, with methods for scanning, handling tuner notifications, and loading EIT data.

classes.name: Schedules
classes.description: Manages broadcast schedules, handles tuner notifications, and processes EIT sections.

classes.name: Schedules::Sink
classes.description: Implements ITuner::INotification to handle tuner activation, deactivation, and state changes.

classes.name: Schedules::Parser
classes.description: Parses DVB EIT sections, manages filtering of sections, and loads schedule data.

methods.name: Schedules::Scan
methods.description: Starts or stops scanning for schedule data.

methods.name: Schedules::StateChange
methods.description: Handles tuner state changes, adding or removing scanners accordingly.

methods.name: Schedules::Load
methods.description: Loads DVB EIT data into the schedule management system.
